# Prompt Polish
**A Work Buddy–style "polish prompt" button for the DeepSeek Harness composer.**

Left-click rewrites your draft into a clearer prompt using the model the
conversation is already on.
Right-click picks a style.
中文说明
## What it does

The button sits in the composer's trailing control seat — immediately before the
model selector, exa

ctly where Work Buddy puts it — and does one thing: it
rewrites the draft you are looking at into a
more effective prompt.

- **Uses the conversation's own model.** No separate model picker, no hidden
default. The Host reads

the Session's durable `modelSelection` projection
first, then the selection the Client reports from

its model seat, then the
profile default. Whichever it lands on is the model you were already using

.
- **Four styles**, right-click to change, remembered across reloads:
*Balanced* (default), *Concis

e*, *Detailed*, *Code-oriented*.
- **A fidelity guard, always on.** Every concrete fact in the origi

nal — numbers,
versions, paths, URLs, quoted strings, code identifiers — must survive
verbatim, and

the rewrite may not inflate past the style's budget. A failed
check triggers exactly one corrective

retry; the guard is a gate, not a loop.
- **Conversation context, always on.** The last few turns ar

e read from the
Session log so the rewrite knows what "it" refers to. Nothing is uploaded
anywhere e

lse; the call goes through the `llm` service you already configured.
- **Revert is one click.** Afte

r a rewrite the button becomes a revert arrow, so
the original text stays one click away. Editing th

e result drops that backup,
because there is nothing left to revert to.
### Behaviour details
| State | What you see |

| Draft empty, nothing rewritten | Button hidden (same as Work Buddy) |
| Draft has text | Spark ico

n; hover shows the tooltip and current style |
| Rewrite running | Spinner; a second click cancels a

nd restores the draft |
| Rewrite succeeded | Revert arrow; click restores the original |
| Rewrite

failed | Draft untouched; the reason appears in the tooltip |
| `adjudicating` / `submitting` phase

uched; the reason appears in the tooltip |
| `adjudicating` / `submitting` phase | Button disabled |

The style menu also opens with Shift+F10 or the context-menu
key, and closes on outside press, Esc,

also opens with Shift+F10 or the context-menu
key, and closes on outside press, Esc, or window blur.
## Install
Install straight from GitHub — one command, nothing to clone:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Or clone the **entire repository**, including all subdirectories, and install
that directory:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Quote Windows paths containing spaces. GitHub's complete ZIP also works after
extraction; downloadin
g only the root files does not produce a usable plugin.

Either way the bundle declares its own `dsh.bundle.patch`, so installing it
inserts the Host row and
the Client bundle in one step; no separate registration.

After installing, the button appears the next time the composer renders. No
rebuild and no extra dep
endency are needed — see below.
## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness with a composer that exposes `conversation.input.right`
and the `llm` + `webServe

r` services.
- The Client bundle injects `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation` and
`@deepseek-ai

/dsh-client-locale`, so the locale and conversation packages must
be present (they ship with the sta
ndard Web/Desktop profile).
## Why there is no build step
Both halves are shipped as plain JavaScript, and that is deliberate:

- the **Host half** is `src/index.js`, an ES module that exports `inject` and
`apply`. It imports no

thing from the Harness packages — a workspace-installed
bundle resolves its own bare imports against

the workspace rather than the
running installation, so the small request vocabulary it needs is bui

lt from
the plain shapes the `llm` service documents.
- the **Client half** is `src/client.js`, a cl

assic script that registers itself
with `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` and resolves

`react`
through the loader's module table.

There is no bundler, no transpiler, and nothing to run before installing. What
you read in `src/` is
exactly what loads.
## Dependencies

Zero runtime dependencies. The Client half requires `react`, which the Harness
loader already provid
es; the Host half requires nothing at all.

## Replication spec

docs/IMPLEMENTATION.md is the build-it-again document: the
behaviour contract, the **verbatim** syst

em and user prompts, the four style
directives, the context block format, the fidelity-guard regexes

, the model
fallback chain, fifteen edge cases, and a fourteen-item self-test. It is written
so anot

her engineer — or another model — can reproduce this plugin on a different
host without reading `src

eer — or another model — can reproduce this plugin on a different
host without reading `src/` first.

If you only want the prompt text to reuse in a single-turn tool, jump to §11 of
that document.
## Verify
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Checks syntax and manifest wiring, then runs 27 HTTP and component-state
regression tests. No `npm i

nstall` required. Running `node scripts/check.mjs`
[该节后续省略]
## Privacy

- The draft, the recent-context block, and the rewrite all travel to the `llm`
provider **you** conf

igured — that is the model call.
- Nothing is sent anywhere else. There is no telemetry, no analytic

s, no remote
endpoint of this plugin's own.
- The chosen style is the only thing persisted, and it l

ives in the browser's
`localStorage` under `dsh-prompt-polish.style`.
- No credential is stored, rea
d, or forwarded by this plugin.
## Compatibility

The Client half targets the slot contract declared by
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation`. If

a future Harness moves that slot,
the button stops appearing rather than breaking the composer — the

registration
is wrapped in `ctx.effect`, so it is disposed cleanly on unload.
